question: What outcome regarding age and death follows from abstaining from food by day?
premises: Non-eating by day is the practice
Age and death are the matters affected
inference: Through abstaining from food by day, one will go beyond death due to age.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with vayo-mṛtyuṃ may mean 'will overcome death from aging'
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death brought by age.
